requirements.requirement: Application data under /srv/data is kept on snapshot-capable storage with a usable recovery snapshot.
requirements.summary: The executor mounted /srv/data from an XFS logical volume, created a filesystem-consistent snapshot, and retained a recovery snapshot whose contents matched the baseline when mounted read-only after reboot.

requirements.requirement: The directory is materially modified after capturing the earlier snapshot.
requirements.summary: After snapshot creation, files were changed, deleted, and added, permissions were altered, and the resulting manifest differed from the snapshot baseline.

requirements.requirement: Restore the exact content captured by the earlier snapshot after the modification.
requirements.summary: The earlier snapshot was merged and the remounted directory's manifest exactly matched the baseline, including tree structure, file checksums, ownership, modes, sizes, timestamps, and symlink targets. The deleted payload returned and the added path disappeared.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied by a directly observed snapshot–modification–rollback transition and exact manifest comparison. The mandatory node1 restart protocol is also complete: healthy pre-restart state, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered storage, data, snapshot, and service state were captured. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.
limitations: The exactness manifest did not cover ACLs, extended attributes, or SELinux labels; exact file bytes, namespace, and the recorded conventional metadata are directly established.

Fixed lifecycle snapshots do not inventory /srv/data or LVM state, so those details rely on the executor command evidence; lifecycle observations independently corroborate the reboot and general system health.

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive system mutations had clear task or mandatory restart-verification roles; no unrelated troubleshooting mutation was identified. Minor evidence residue remained: /root baseline, modified, and restored manifests from cmd-f9a9653e8ccf4892, cmd-763e0965ee934eb9, and cmd-2ad1da74cdfc4731; /tmp pre-restart, post-restart, and snapshot manifests from cmd-1a21d33053ae4924, cmd-4d2cdf8373ec4d8b, and cmd-c447ba5f10e645c4; and the empty snapshot mount-point directory created by cmd-c447ba5f10e645c4. None is shown as removed. The fixed final snapshot confirms the three /tmp manifests remained, while package health, listening services, and failed-unit state remained healthy.
